response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, COUNT(*) AS ng FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share, 1.0 / t.ng AS avg_share FROM g, t) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_selected, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > avg_share
